name: Classic Rift - Original Lights
creator: thekillerey
description:
Classic Rift – Original Lights replaces the current lightmaps with lighting that closely matches the original Classic Summoner’s Rift.

This improves the brightness, shadows, colors, and overall atmosphere of the map, restoring the intended classic appearance while keeping the original map assets unchanged. The result is a brighter, more natural-looking Rift that feels much closer to the original version.
